title: Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing
abstract: arXiv:2611.20075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corre

translated_title: 移动平台着陆中掩码条件视觉强化学习的提示词重新指定与目标掩码可用性
translated_abstract: 视觉强化学习（RL）策略在将无人机降落到移动平台时，如果着陆平台的外观与训练时使用的不同，可能会失败。使用二值目标掩码作为视觉输入，可以去除大部分像素级外观信息，同时保留目标的空间表示，并允许通过文本提示来指定目标。在仿真中，我们测试了冻结（固定权重）的基于掩码的 DrQ-v2 策略，在仅改变其微调的 SAM 3 检测器提示词的情况下，能否应对新的着陆平台。一个香蕉主题的着陆平台将着陆成功率从 75.6% 降低到 12.0%，并且在原始提示词下 SAM 3 很少能检测到它。在测试了多个候选提示词后选定的修改版提示词，在没有任何权重更新的情况下，将成功率恢复到了 68.4%。在使用真实掩码训练的策略进行的另一项独立实验中，当平台可见时填补缺失的掩码，对比测试的掩码质心和面积相关性方法，对成功着陆的帮助要大得多。
tldr: 仅通过重新指定文本提示词而无需更新任何策略权重，冻结的掩码条件视觉强化学习无人机着陆策略即可适应外观新颖的着陆平台，将成功率从 12.0% 恢复至 68.4%。
en_tdlr: Re-specifying only the text prompt—without any weight updates—enables a frozen mask-conditioned visual RL drone landing policy to adapt to a novel-appearing pad, restoring success from 12.0% to 68.4%.
